trip.title: China Winter Adventure 2026 — Detailed Flight Plan
trip.description: Dec 3–13 China winter trip for 2. Main route Bangkok–Kunming–Chengdu–Jiuzhaigou–Chengdu–Shangri-La–Lijiang–Dali–Kunming–Xiamen–Bangkok. Flight options from Trip.com screenshots are NOT booked; "ALT" flights are alternatives that conflict with the original plan (marked optional). All times are China time (UTC+8). Other transport times remain unconfirmed. Budget THB 50,000 for two is very tight.

activities.title: ALT: Flight Bangkok → Chengdu Tianfu (Kunming Airlines, 1 stop)
activities.notes: Flight option from Trip.com screenshots, NOT booked. Times are China time (UTC+8, the trip time zone); Bangkok is 1 hour behind. Add the flight number once booked to get live status. 19:30 Bangkok → 11:10 next day, 14h40m, 1 stop (city not shown: ask before booking). ฿3,815 × 2. ALTERNATIVE to the Kunming first night: it skips Kunming on Dec 3–4. Price is in this note (not in the budget) because it is an alternative.

activities.title: ALT: Flight Chengdu Tianfu → Shangri-La (Sichuan Airlines A319)
activities.notes: Flight option from Trip.com screenshots, NOT booked. Times are China time (UTC+8, the trip time zone); Bangkok is 1 hour behind. Add the flight number once booked to get live status. Checked baggage 20 kg. ฿2,815 × 2. CONFLICTS with Jiuzhaigou on Dec 5 and the Chengdu hotel nights; only use it if you drop or move Jiuzhaigou. Price is in this note (not in the budget) because it is an alternative.

activities.title: Flight: Kunming → Xiamen (return ticket, leg 1)
activities.notes: Flight option from Trip.com screenshots, NOT booked. Times are China time (UTC+8, the trip time zone); Bangkok is 1 hour behind. Add the flight number once booked to get live status. One ticket KMG → XMN → BKK, ฿3,805 × 2 (paid with PromptPay price). Checked bag goes through to Bangkok: pack the Xiamen night in your 8 kg carry-on.

activities.title: Flight: Xiamen → Bangkok (return ticket, leg 2)
activities.notes: Flight option from Trip.com screenshots, NOT booked. Times are China time (UTC+8, the trip time zone); Bangkok is 1 hour behind. Add the flight number once booked to get live status. Leg 2 of the same ticket (21h55m stop in Xiamen). Lands 18:45 Bangkok time (19:45 China time). No baggage recheck.
